title: Austin Runoff Election Results Certified
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Canvassing Meeting
summary:
*   A special meeting was held to address urgent city business.
*   The primary agenda item was to officially confirm the results of the June 11 municipal runoff election.
*   This action formally approved the winners of the city's recent election contests.
